name: Small Talk
tagline: A minimal messenger built on the Matrix network
description:
Small Talk is a lightweight messaging app built on Matrix, the open network for secure, decentralized chat. It focuses on doing the basics well, letting you send end-to-end encrypted messages without a cluttered interface full of features you don't need.

If you want a straightforward way to chat on Matrix without the complexity of larger apps, Small Talk keeps things simple.
